transcript.content: Hello, I’m glad you came in today. What brings you in?
Well, I came in because... most days I wake up with this heavy, hollow feeling in my chest. It's like the old Ruben—the guy who could talk to anybody and actually enjoy his day—is just gone.
Have you ever had a distinct period when you felt unusually energized or unusually irritable compared with your normal self?

No, not really. I mean, I definitely haven't felt energized. It's been pretty much the exact opposite of that for a long time now. And as far as being irritable... maybe I get a little frustrated sometimes just because I can't seem to get going, but I wouldn't say I've ever felt wired or unusually angry. Just... really drained.
How long have you been feeling this heavy, hollow way most days?

It's been about eight months now. Yeah, right around eight months. It started when the new regional manager took over and started coming down on me. He just... he started taking away accounts I’d handled for years. Ever since that happened, I've just felt this way.
During these eight months, have you lost interest or pleasure in activities that you usually enjoy?

Yeah, I have. I used to look forward to a lot of things... bowling, working out in the garden, taking my wife to gallery shows, or even just going dancing. But now, I just sit there. I end up making excuses not to go because none of it really feels worth the effort anymore.
Have you been having trouble sleeping during this period?

Yeah, I have. It's been pretty bad, honestly. At night I just... I lie there staring at the ceiling, replaying everything from work over and over in my head. And when I actually do manage to fall asleep, I end up waking up around three or four in the morning. I can't get back to sleep after that. I just wake up already worn out... and just dreading the day.
Have you been having trouble concentrating or making decisions during this period?

No, not really. I mean, my focus is alright. I haven't noticed any real trouble concentrating on things, even with the lack of sleep. And making decisions... no, that hasn't been an issue either. I can still do all that just fine.
Have you had any thoughts that you would be better off dead or thoughts of killing yourself?

Yeah, I have. I've been having these thoughts lately that... maybe my wife and kids would just be better off if I didn't wake up. It's hard to say out loud, but those thoughts really scare me. They scare me enough that I just don't trust myself the way I used to.
Have you noticed any significant change in your appetite or weight during these eight months?

No, not really. My appetite's been about the same as usual, honestly. I haven't noticed any real changes in how much I'm eating, and my weight hasn't fluctuated much either. It's just... everything else feels off, but not that.
During these eight months, have you often felt unusually tired or lacking energy?

No, I haven't really noticed that. I mean, my energy levels feel pretty normal for the most part. I'm not dragging or feeling unusually tired during the day... so, no, that hasn't really been a problem for me.
During these eight months, have you often felt worthless or excessively guilty about things?

Yes, a lot. I just... I keep telling myself I'm useless now. I've spent all these years taking care of clients, providing for my family, and it feels like none of that even counts anymore because I can't even handle my job now. It's just this constant feeling of being completely worthless.
